_about: Every line the Godslayer announcers can say. Each pack is a voice with a character, and reads one of the scripts below. kind: call = the kill call, over an impact hit; points = called out; aside = a quieter remark after the call (the joke is the contrast); title = proud. Clips named x_1, x_2 are takes of one line: the addon never plays the same take twice running, and a pack may have more or fewer takes than another. Words in [square brackets] steer the delivery and are never spoken. stutter: calls whose first syllable is repeated, for the top of the ladder. weight: how often the pack comes up when the announcer is set to mix. tools/build_voice.py turns this into Godslayer/Sounds/<pack>/<clip>.ogg, Godslayer/Sounds/sfx, Godslayer/Sounds/music and Godslayer/Voice.lua. An sfx with steps is also written as name_1, name_2 and so on, each raised by that many semitones: the kill sound climbs a scale as the hunt goes on.

hunt.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Dark epic hunt theme for a player-versus-player kill streak: pounding war drums and taiko at 100 BPM, low brass ostinato, aggressive staccato strings, choir stabs, a menacing hybrid trap bass under it. Starts at full intensity from the first second with no slow intro, stays driving and relentless, ends on the same groove so it loops cleanly.

hunt2.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. The second, bigger phase of a dark epic hunt theme for a player on an unstoppable kill streak: faster pounding war drums and taiko at 120 BPM, soaring heroic brass melody over a low brass ostinato, full choir chanting wordless syllables, racing staccato strings, a heavy hybrid trap bass. Triumphant and overwhelming, starts at full intensity from the first second with no intro, stays relentless, ends on the same groove so it loops cleanly.
